description.value: Sabà Bistro is a woman and family-owned Mediterranean-inspired restaurant nestled in historic Fort Langley. The ingredient-forward menu features a crafted balance of local and seasonal flavours, with dishes designed to be shared family style. It operates alongside a sister café and an upcoming pizzeria, both within walking distance on Mavis Avenue.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sabà Bistro at 9220 Glover Rd in Fort Langley as a Mediterranean-inspired, woman and family-owned restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating (corroborated by OSM outdoor_seating=yes and indoor_seating=yes). The cafe menu includes a 'Grab & Go' section and 'PRE-ORDER' option, supporting takeout. Vegan and GF options are explicitly listed on the menu (e.g. 'VEGAN BURRITO', multiple items marked 'Gf option'). No mention of bike parking, water refills, Wi-Fi, or charging on the website or in OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Mediterranean restaurant in Fort Langley with outdoor seating, takeout options, and dietary accommodations; a useful stop for touring cyclists passing through the Township of Langley.
